## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change.

## Scope and compatibility

- Affected index / storage backend:
- CMake options:
- Public API, parameters, file/model format, or platform impact:

## Validation

Include exact commands and results. Identify checks that were skipped or could
not run; distinguish build success from integration and performance validation.

- [ ] Relevant build and tests
- [ ] Documentation checker and affected examples
- [ ] Documentation / compatibility notes updated
- [ ] No generated artifacts or machine-specific configuration

For performance changes, include revision IDs, complete configuration, dataset,
hardware/topology, warmup, repetition count, recall, latency/QPS measurement
definitions, and raw-output location.
